title: Deposits
summary: End-to-end generic Deposits business journey covering transactional/demand, savings, and term/fixed/time deposit product selection, eligibility, configuration, setup, funding, interest, servicing, withdrawal, maturity, renewal, closure and controlled exceptions.

payload.text: Deposits enables customers to hold, fund and manage money through transactional/demand, savings, and term/fixed/time deposit products. The Journey separates common lifecycle controls from capabilities that apply only where supported by product configuration.

payload.title: Deposits – End-to-End General Business Process Flow
payload.description: BPMN-aligned flow for generic transactional, savings, and term/fixed/time deposits across product selection, eligibility, configuration, setup, funding, servicing, withdrawal, maturity, renewal, closure, rework and controlled exceptions.

scope.start: Customer or initiating user expresses intent to open, place, fund, service, withdraw or mature an eligible deposit product.
scope.successEnd: The deposit is activated, remains validly serviced, is renewed, or is paid out and closed with authoritative references and audit evidence.
scope.policyQualification: Product-specific behavior applies only where supported by applicable product configuration and according to applicable bank policy and jurisdiction.

businessRules.rule: Only products available to the customer, channel and jurisdiction may be selected.
Customer, ownership and entitlement eligibility must be resolved before creation.
Product family determines whether tenor, maturity and renewal instructions apply.
Currency and amount must satisfy applicable product configuration.
A funding source must be eligible, accessible and sufficiently funded before confirmed funding.
Term-product value and maturity dates must derive from governed configuration.
Interest and payout instructions must be supported by the selected product.
Duplicate requests must be resolved before account or placement creation.
Approval must be performed by an authorized role when required.
Uncertain creation responses must be reconciled before retry.
Uncertain funding responses must be reconciled before retry.
Activation requires all mandatory creation and funding conditions to be resolved.
Withdrawal capability and amount depend on product configuration and current status.
Early termination treatment follows applicable product configuration and policy.
Maturity processing must use a valid current instruction.
Renewal requires continued product and customer eligibility.
Closure requires outstanding obligations and pending operations to be resolved.
Every material decision, retry and manual action must retain audit evidence.
